title: What's eating my disk — free disk space analyser in your browser
description: Pick a folder and see what is using the space: a treemap of the biggest folders, the fifty biggest files, duplicates matched by content rather than name, and large files you have not touched in years. Runs entirely in your browser on Windows, macOS and Linux. Nothing is installed and nothing is uploaded. A free alternative to CleanMyMac, DaisyDisk and the disk cleaner apps.
